Dara (Product): Short sync: we need a compact GA checklist that sales can hand to pilots. Must include SLA bullets, support response times, pricing opt-ins, and monitoring commitments.
Ibrahim (Eng): Agreed. Also call out which model families are eligible for the low-latency promise. We should avoid a blanket p95 target across all models.
Tess (SRE): Draft SLOs: Availability 99.9% monthly; p95 latency target depends on model family (lowlatency p95 < 150ms). Alert rules: page when p99 > 350ms for 5m or error rate > 5% for 3m. Canary requirement: 10% for 24h on any major rollout.
Hector (FinOps): For pilots we recommend invoicing at estimated consumption with a 30-day true-up. For low-latency tier add a +12% surcharge or an option to commit to reserved capacity.
Rina (Docs): I'll make a one-pager customer promise with short bullets and an FAQ entry for burst vs reserved capacity. Need exact wording for SLOs and the billing holdback.
Marta (Support): Support targets: P1 ack within 1h, P2 ack within 4h business hours. We will provide a canned status blurb: "We routed traffic to a compatible model variant to keep requests healthy; investigating."
Ibrahim (Eng): Fallback plan: map every low-latency model to a compatible standard model variant. I'll add env var toggles and a smoke test script.
release-bot: Staging release: ga-checklist-v0.9 started at 2025-07-25T11:42:00Z
Tess (SRE): Add to runbook: automated rollback if canary error rate delta > 3x baseline for 10m. Also document maintenance windows and emergency maintenance etiquette (1h notice).
Dara (Product): Action list: Hector -> finalize pilot billing language, Tess -> finalize alert rules & runbook links, Rina -> publish one-pager and FAQ, Ibrahim -> push fallback mappings + smoke test, Marta -> upload support templates. Please ack when ready.
Hector (FinOps): ack, sending sample invoice examples by EOD.
Rina (Docs): ack, publishing draft and pinging sales for review.
Marta (Support): ack, will add incident templates.
Ibrahim (Eng): ack, will PR fallback mapping and test script.
Tess (SRE): ack, will add PD mappings and playbooks.
Dara (Product): thanks — if no blockers I'll mark this GA checklist approved and we'll include it in the pilot onboarding email.
